code_assessment.input_bound: InventoryYaml.java:42-57. Each read uses an 8192-byte scratch buffer. count > MAX_CHAIN_RECORD_BYTES - retained.size() is checked before appending and parsing; retained.size never exceeds 16777216. Subtraction avoids overflow. A file of exactly N bytes is read through EOF; any next byte causes rejection on the next non-empty read, including trailing/comment bytes.
code_assessment.read_ahead: The code reads an ordinary chunk before checking its length; a failing read can consume up to 8192 excess bytes. It does not promise to issue a read of exactly the remaining budget plus one. This preserves the documented acceptance boundary and rejects before YAML parsing.
code_assessment.memory: ByteArrayOutputStream stores a finite input payload and toByteArray copies it. Its capacity/growth and SnakeYAML's object/character allocations are additional to the 16 MiB payload; this is not a 16 MiB heap/RSS guarantee. No product Workflow Resource Policy or runtime budget is altered.
code_assessment.resources: The file InputStream closes on parse completion and all caught failures via try-with-resources. The byte-array stream owns no external resource.
code_assessment.parser: InventoryYaml.java:60-67 shares SafeConstructor, duplicate-key=false, recursive-key=false, max collection aliases=0 and depth=30. Only chain records have 16777216 parser code points; load(...) retains 3000000. Environment and execution configuration loaders are unchanged.
